description: Move items, gas and players. Reports first; confirm: true moves. gas and player are cheats: ask the user.
text: Items go into or out of an Ingot Vault or SDB Silo store when to or source is one.

options.to: item: the holder that gets them (a vault or silo makes a store move). gas: a thing or room.
options.source: item: a vault or silo. gas: a thing, room or planet.

item.summary: items and kits (a kit such as Kit (Battery Large) is an item; a built structure is not) into a slot or the player's hands with the game's own moves; into or out of a vault or silo store

id.description: The item(s); for a vault or silo deposit, whole things by id.

quantity.description: Slot move: how many off the stack, default the whole item. Out of a vault: grams of ingot or a count of ore or ice; out of a silo: an item count; required for both.

to.description: The holder that gets them: a container, belt, suit, "player", a vault or a silo.

slot.description: A slot index of to, or "auto" (the default). Given, the move is a slot move even into a vault's or silo's own slots; force needs an index.

merge.description: Join a matching stack in the slot.

force.description: Into an empty slot by index even when hidden. Cheat.

allow.description: in_use: take a part its device is using; ground: what does not fit goes on the ground.

moves.description: Up to 64 moves in order, each {id, quantity, to, slot, merge, allow}.

source.description: A vault or silo to take from.

prefab.description: Into a store: filter; out of a store: the item to take (whole name or hash).

reagent.description: Out of a vault: the stored reagent (Iron, Steel).

items.description: Store moves: lines {id, quantity} (deposit) or {prefab, reagent, quantity} (vault to vault: grams of ingot, a count of ore or ice; "all" moves every line; required vault to vault, where a top-level prefab and quantity become one line).

within.description: Into a store: only things inside this holder.

at_most.description: Into a store: move at most this many things, nearest first.
at_most.x-script: Into a store: move at most this many things, nearest first. (default vault 256, silo 64)

text: Which handler runs: with slot or moves, a slot move. Otherwise a vault or silo as to or source makes a store move; everything else is a slot move. The reply's first key route names it: slot, into_vault, out_of_vault, vault_to_vault, into_silo or out_of_silo.
Filters (prefab parts, name, location, within, near, category) work for moves into a store; slot moves take ids.
Out of a vault: move {what: "item", source: "4191359", prefab: "ItemIronIngot", quantity: 500, to: "player", confirm: true}.
Into a silo by filter: move {what: "item", to: "5200100", prefab: "*Ore*", location: "player"}.

Filters (prefab parts, name, location, within, near, category) work for moves into a store; slot moves take ids.

gas.summary: move gas and liquid between atmospheres or rooms, or delete it, with no pipe or pump

source.description: A thing id, "looking_at", "planet" (with delete), or a room {room} or {room_of}.

to.description: A thing id, "looking_at" or a room; left out with delete.

delete.description: Destroy the gas instead of moving it.

gases.description: Gas names as inspect atmosphere gives them; left out, every gas and liquid.

amount_mol.description: Moles of each gas, capped at what is there; left out, all.

allow.description: burst: move past a burst rating.

joined.description: Treat atmospheres the game mixes every tick as one.

text: Applied at the next atmospherics tick. A confirmed move waits for it (max_wait, default 30 s) and answers status applied or failed; past max_wait it answers queued and its id (inspect job).
